summary: The chapter adheres strictly to the brief, plan, and research sources. It provides actionable guidance on supplier performance scorecards, compliance gap reviews, status transitions (probation and disqualification), and audit evidence retention. Workflow roles, inputs, decisions, records, exceptions, and software evaluation criteria are methodically presented. All ISO/IAF APG guidance is properly contextualized with standard advisory notes, ICC Supplier Quality module capabilities are framed accurately for demonstration testing, hypothetical examples are explicitly labeled, and unassigned FAQ content is correctly omitted.

glossary.definition: A supervised qualification state applied to an external provider whose quality or delivery results have deteriorated, subject to mandatory operational restrictions and defined recovery conditions.
The formal termination of an approved supplier relationship for a category or commodity that immediately blocks the placement of new purchase orders.

decisions: Assign monthly supplier rating tier based on compiled scorecard metrics
Determine whether compliance record deficiencies warrant operational intervention
Authorize supplier status transition from approved to probation or disqualification
Determine whether supplier governance evidence package is complete for third-party or customer audit
